mapper.insert: insert into ai_conversation (id, user_id, org_id, title, agent_key, agent_version, status, created_at, updated_at) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{orgId}, #{title}, #{agentKey}, #{agentVersion}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: select * from ai_conversation where user_id = #{userId} order by updated_at desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(*) from ai_conversation where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: update ai_conversation set updated_at = #{now} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: update ai_conversation set message_seq = message_seq + 1, last_message_at = now(), updated_at = now() where id = #{conversationId} returning message_seq
select * from ai_message where conversation_id = #{conversationId} and seq > #{afterSeq} order by seq asc limit #{limit}
select count(*) from ai_message where conversation_id = #{conversationId}
mapper.update: update ai_message set content = #{content}, status = #{status} where id = #{messageId}
